findings.title: Scope guard has no negative test: nothing pins demo-CTA absence on /tools/*, /resources, /resources/:slug
findings.detail: Spec AC requires no demo CTA on /tools/*, /resources, /resources/:slug; behavior verified correct (guide_demo_cta called only in the 11 guide views), but no test pins it — a future composition/handler change could silently leak the CTA.
findings.recommended_fix: Add assertions that rendered /tools and /resources pages do not contain guide-demo-cta, mirroring the positive test.

findings.title: Placement (directly under signup CTA) and secondary-weight classes are unasserted
findings.detail: Spec AC: signup CTA stays visually primary, demo CTA border-only/outline directly under it. Test asserts only testid + href presence, not order or classes.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert string.indexOf(guide-demo-cta) > string.indexOf(inline_cta marker) and spot-check a demo_cta_base class fragment.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 100% (presence on all 11 guides, FULL), P1 <90% (scope-guard negative + placement/weight gaps), overall >=80%.
findings.recommended_fix: Close the two P1 gaps above to raise the gate to PASS.

findings.title: guide_demo_cta doc comment misdescribes placement: 'closing signup CTA' holds for only 4 of 10 view_cta guides
findings.detail: Comment says 'placed directly under the guide's closing signup CTA (inline_cta) where one exists', singling out part-4-tenancy as the exception; rtb_disputes and property_management_fees (also letting_agent_costs, notice_periods, rental_income_tax, rtb_registration) render FAQ/sources after the CTA block, so it is mid-page there too.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword comment: 'directly under view_cta() where present; end of content otherwise'.

findings.title: Issue's verbatim copy block (heading, subline, button label) is asserted nowhere
findings.detail: Brand copy is mandated exact by the issue but no test pins the three strings; copy drift would pass CI.
findings.recommended_fix: Add string.contains assertions for the heading, subline, and button label in the same loop.

findings.title: guide_demo_cta re-implements inline_cta's card scaffold instead of a shared CTA-card helper
findings.detail: Card div, max-w-xl text column, shrink-0 button column and flex/stack classes are duplicated from inline_cta (itself shared by multiple callers); only card style, heading size and button differ.
findings.recommended_fix: Consider a parameterized cta_card helper if a third CTA variant appears.
